name: libxsmm-panel32-next-operands-before-branch
hypothesis: Implement the selected software pipeline in the active panel32 K loop, starting from eb091b1e…. A prologue loads K=0. Each of 511 loop iterations updates ZA0–ZA3, loads the next operands into the same registers, advances the pointers, and branches. A final drain updates all four tiles for K=511 without another load. This preserves 512 loads per operand stream, pointer totals, and each output's FP32 accumulation order without register copies or extra accumulators. Placing loads before loop control tests load-latency overlap; benefit is unverified. This active-panel32 change is absent from the supplied measured history. Packing, allocation, stores, ABI, stack handling, fallback and all BSD notices remain unchanged. No tools or tests were run. Compilation, all 48 public cases at tolerance 0.002, ten validation reports, ten alternating fresh imported controls, the fixed promotion gate and holdout validation remain required. No throughput or repeatability gain is established.
